objective: Verify whether the product 'Sika Professional Sika 28T-UV8 Sealant' with sealant type hybrid sealant, color family Gray, and volume 300 ml exists in the catalogue, and if it does, check whether the catalogue also claims volume 310 ml; if the extra claim is absent, answer <NO> with the product SKU.
